llm_response.reason: The website mimics the legitimate Blutsgeschwister brand, offers substantial discounts, and lacks mandatory legal/company information required by German/EU law for online retailers (e.g., business address, Impressum, or registration details). The domain name is unrelated to the official brand, there is only a generic contact form, and SSL issues are present. These are all strong indicators of a scam site attempting to impersonate a real online fashion retailer.
